name: Button
purpose: Commit or trigger one action.
usage: Use one primary per view. Danger is only for confirmation.
behavior: Native disabled and loading prevent activation. Label remains visible.
avoid: Use a link for navigation. Do not use arbitrary colour or style props.

name: IconButton
purpose: A compact action represented by an approved glyph.
usage: Supply a label that describes the action.
behavior: Accessible name is required. Native button semantics.
avoid: Use Button when a visible label would help.

name: Icon
purpose: An approved decorative Klein glyph.
usage: Meaning belongs in the parent control label.
behavior: Hidden from assistive technology.
avoid: Do not import a separate icon library or draw page-local icons.

name: Input
purpose: Native text entry for custom field composition.
usage: Prefer Field. Standalone Input needs an accessible label.
behavior: Use native value/onChange and inputMode for numeric entry.
avoid: No checkbox/radio/file variants; those require dedicated components.

name: Field
purpose: Text entry with an associated label, help and error.
usage: The caller validates and supplies error text.
behavior: Label and help/error IDs are generated; disabled/readOnly/required stay native.
avoid: Do not use placeholders as labels. Use one field per Field.

name: NumericValue
purpose: Already formatted money, dates, percentages and measured values.
usage: Pass locale-aware text; choose semantic tone in the data layer.
behavior: Uses monospace tabular numerals.
avoid: Never infer good/bad from arithmetic sign or calculate totals here.

name: PageHeader
purpose: The page title and its primary actions.
usage: One h1 and at most one primary action per page.
behavior: Actions wrap at narrow widths.
avoid: No prose lead, invented subtitle or duplicated header.

name: RouteTabs
purpose: Navigation between routes.
usage: The application supplies hrefs and current route ID.
behavior: Real links; aria-current marks the active page.
avoid: Use Tabs for local panels. Do not drive page routes with local tab state.

name: Tabs
purpose: Controlled selection between local panels.
usage: Use inside a drawer or a local panel, not page sub-navigation.
behavior: Arrow/Home/End move focus; Enter/Space activate. Disabled tabs are skipped.
avoid: Do not replace RouteTabs or duplicate navigation state.

name: ViewControlPanel
purpose: The single control region above a view body.
usage: Supply approved controls and trailing actions.
behavior: Mixed native controls retain normal Tab order.
avoid: Do not add a second toolbar; extend the actions slot.

name: ViewSection
purpose: A flat titled region inside a view.
usage: Use for a chart or sub-list in an approved layout.
behavior: Heading and optional actions share a band.
avoid: Do not wrap it in a decorative Card or add shadow/rounded corners.

name: ViewLayout
purpose: One of five approved view-body layouts.
usage: Choose single, 2:1, 2:2, 3:3 or tree:detail.
behavior: Owns internal gutters and scroll behaviour. Grids stack on narrow screens.
avoid: Do not add page padding or recreate these grids in consumers.

name: ListViewTemplate
purpose: Canonical header, navigation, controls and scrolling body.
usage: Supply PageHeader, optional RouteTabs, one ViewControlPanel and body.
behavior: Place in a height-constrained application shell; body scrolls independently.
avoid: No backend, router or saved preference state belongs here.

name: EdgeToEdgeLayout
purpose: A full-width dashboard stack with hairline-separated bands.
usage: Use for edge-to-edge product surfaces, with no outer padding or decorative cards.
behavior: Bands own gutters; narrow layouts stack; grow fills the parent.
avoid: Do not add gaps between bands or wrap tables in padded containers.

name: DashboardBand

usage: Use for edge-to-edge product surfaces, with no outer padding or decorative cards.
